import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static String s;
    static boolean[] visited = new boolean[1000005];
    static long k, p;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static void explore(int idx) {
        if (!visited[idx]) {
            visited[idx] = true;
            explore((int)((k * idx) % p));
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        p = scanner.nextLong();
        k = scanner.nextLong();
        long result = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
            if (!visited[i]) {
                explore(i);
                result = (result * p) % MOD;
            }
        }
        if (k == 1) {
            result = (result * p) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
